description: This file defines warning message configurations and extends several OpenERP (Odoo) models such as res.partner, sale.order, purchase.order, account.invoice, stock.picking, product.product, sale.order.line, and purchase.order.line to add warning and message functionalities for different business objects and actions.

classes.name: res_partner
classes.description: Extends res.partner to include warning message fields for sales, purchase, picking, and invoice.

classes.name: sale_order
classes.description: Extends sale.order to add warning logic in onchange_partner_id method.

classes.name: purchase_order
classes.description: Extends purchase.order to add warning logic in onchange_partner_id method.

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Extends account.invoice to include warning logic in onchange_partner_id method.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extends stock.picking to include warning logic in onchange_partner_in method.

classes.name: product_product
classes.description: Extends product.product to add warning fields for sale and purchase order lines.

classes.name: sale_order_line
classes.description: Extends sale.order.line to include warning logic in product_id_change method.

classes.name: purchase_order_line
classes.description: Extends purchase.order.line to include warning logic in product_id_change method.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Handles warning logic for partner changes in sale.order, purchase.order, and account.invoice models.

methods.name: onchange_partner_in
methods.description: Handles warning logic for partner changes in stock.picking.

methods.name: product_id_change
methods.description: Handles warning logic for product selection in sale.order.line and purchase.order.line.
